summary.strategic_insight: High-risk periods: May 2026, June 2026, July 2026, August 2026, September 2026, October 2026. Escalate monitoring and resource allocation.  Sustained delay rate of 35% requires structural process optimisation across the horizon.  Elevated fraud index (10.0%) warrants enhanced investigation protocols.  Proactive interventions could prevent up to 108K TND in losses over 6 months – ROI positive.
